Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_hierarchy ON parent_molregno from parent molecule_dictionary (CHEMBL1336) to link parent and all salts; compound_structures ON molregno; compound_records ON molregno; docs ON doc_id; activities ON record_id; assays ON assay_id; target_dictionary ON tid. Filter: parent molecule chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'; target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'; standard_type = 'IC50'; standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Limit: None.
